about: Round 4's routing table, pre-registered data. Decided by routing.py only, from harness-side records only, never from the agent's text. Route, phase and batch-state strings are graders/labels4.py's and are checked against it on load. A row matches when the take is in its phase, every all_of condition holds, at least one any_of condition holds (when any_of is given), and no none_of condition holds. The winning rows are the matched rows at the highest precedence level; matched rows at that level that name different routes are a tie and are refused, as is an input that matches no row.
plan_source: Round 4 plan, 'What round 4 measures' > 'Outcomes' > routing table and its precedence paragraph; CP1 task 'CREATE .../routing.py'.
precedence_source: Plan: 'pause, then aborted, then harness-error, then graded'. Lane w1b decision: rehearsal shares harness-error's level (both are harness faults, split only by phase), so a double match between them is refused, never picked.

rate_limit_markers.source: Lane w1b proposal, to be confirmed by the home session against round 3's driver: the API's HTTP 429 status and its rate_limit_error type. Plan: 'a pre-registered rate-limit marker in the API-error record'.

operator_reasons_status: PENDING. Round 3's operator-side reasons (evals/gap-study-3/prereg.json rehearsal_reasons and driver_decided_reasons, and evals/gap-study-3/check_take.py) were NOT read by lane w1b: a safety classifier denied the read, and the lane's hard rules forbid routing around a denial. Until the home session lists them here, routing.py refuses any checker reason id, because an id not in this list matches no row.

rehearsal.source: Plan: 're-run in the same slot (capped at 3 per half-cell, round 3's cap)'.

harness-error.beyond_cap: published as harness-error in its own column; leaves the denominator, the cell's n printed
harness-error.source: Plan: 'one re-run in the same slot (capped at 2 per half-cell)'.

pause.source: Plan: 're-run in the same slot under round 3's pause_cap'. PENDING: round 3's pause_cap lives in evals/gap-study-3/prereg.json, which lane w1b did not read (classifier denial). batch.py refuses to start while this cap is null.

graded.source: Plan: 'no try is ever discarded or re-run for something the agent did'.

rows.source: Plan table row 1: 'before the agent's first turn | preflight failure'. Also a box-only record (CP1 task: 'the box-only records (preflight, ...)').
Plan table row 1: 'container start failure'. Lane w1b decision: a container that started and exited before the first turn counts as a start failure.
Plan table row 1: 'API error'. A rate-limit marker also matches rate-limit (pause), which wins on precedence.

CP1 task: 'the box-only records (preflight, sidecar health, ...)'. Lane w1b decision: a watcher fault before the first turn is a rehearsal, as every other harness fault in that phase. The stop record is not read here: before the first turn it may legitimately not exist yet.
Plan table last row: 'each operator-side reason the copied checker keeps ... a rehearsal before the first turn'. Matches any id in operator_reasons (PENDING, see operator_reasons_status).

CP1 task: 'The sidecar's health and the operator-diff check run inside that same step'; CP3 endstate: 'The drive step has already routed any operator-step diff that no event explains'. Phase split as the plan's last row.
Plan table last row: 'round 3's finalize abort (drive.py:1417) ... a rehearsal before the first turn'. Cited from the plan text; evals/gap-study-3/drive.py was not read by lane w1b.
Plan table: 'any time | a pre-registered rate-limit marker in the API-error record | pause'.
Plan table: 'after the first turn | the turn's out-of-memory or pids-limit counters rose ... whatever the exit looked like | aborted ... never re-run'.
Plan table: 'after the first turn | API-error record'.
Plan table: 'after the first turn | ... container exit'.
Plan table: 'a watcher gap (start or stop record missing, non-zero exit, queue overflow)'; edge case: 'The watcher overflows or dies mid-take: the take routes as harness-error'.

Plan table: 'an init event whose model, mode or version differs from the pin'; testing strategy: 'a mismatch on the last turn of an otherwise graded take is a harness-error'. Lane w1b decision: a turn with no init event at all counts as a mismatch.

Plan table: 'after the first turn | a non-zero exec exit with no API-error record and no rise in those counters | harness-error'. Lane w1b decision: the exit of a turn the host ended as timed-out is not read, because 'a timeout stays the agent's' and the host's own kill exits non-zero.
Plan table last row: '... harness-error after it'. Matches any id in operator_reasons (PENDING, see operator_reasons_status).
CP3 endstate VALIDATE: 'an unexplained diff that routes as harness-error'.
Plan table last row: round 3's finalize abort (drive.py:1417), 'harness-error after it'.
Plan: graded is the route of a take no harness row claims. Lane w1b decision: graded is a row of its own, so an input no row matches is refused, never defaulted to graded.
Plan: 'A timeout stays the agent's (timed-out, as in rounds 1-3), because an agent that loops is behaving'.

Plan table: 'any time | the agent's own text or actions reaching the token, the account email, a study path or anything outside the run tree | graded as usual; masked, never deleted, before commit, and counted as an event'. Read from the drive step's count, never from the text. Lane w1b decision: phase after-first-turn, since before it the agent has neither text nor actions.

CP1 task: 'the box-only records (..., a quiescence kill)'; CP3 endstate: 'Writes by a background process the driver recorded and stopped at the cap are attributed to the turn that launched it'. Lane w1b decision: the agent's own behaviour, so graded, counted as an event.
